This is an exciting opportunity to lead and further develop an already robust Countywide employee wellness program that supports the health, engagement, and overall well\-being of the County workforce.

**About the Employee Wellness Program**


The County of San Mateo’s Employee Wellness Program reflects the County’s belief that a healthy, productive workforce is essential to delivering high\-quality public service. The program is designed to help employees be their healthiest and best selves, at work and in their day\-to\-day lives outside of work.


Through wellness programming, education, policy development, and organizational initiatives, the Employee Wellness Program supports **whole\-person well\-being** with an emphasis on **physical, mental, emotional, and social wellness**. The program aims to strengthen morale and engagement, build a culture of belonging, and support employees with the tools and resources they need to thrive at work and in life.


Current and emerging program priorities include:

* Creating a culture of health and well\-being
* Promoting total\-person wellness through inclusive activities and services
* Expanding opportunities related to the Wellness Dividend
* Increasing mental and emotional well\-being offerings
* Enhancing technology through the wellness portal

new_jobs.description:
**OUR EXCITING OPPORTUNITY**




*Community Action Partnership* has an exciting opportunity for

***Financial Empowerment Program Coordinator***




In this role, the Financial Empowerment Program Coordinator will assist with the development and implementation of program procedures and ensure that requirements are aligned to build sustainable support in impacting the lives of hundreds of residents; playing a critical part in the work and dedication of *Community Action Partnership of Orange County’s* initiatives. It’s leadership with a cause and the rewards are immeasurable!

**WHO WE ARE**


Born out of the War on Poverty more than 50 years ago, Community Action Partnership Orange County (CAP OC) is a trusted resource for Orange County community members who face obstacles such as food insecurity, unemployment, economic turmoil and more. We walk alongside the people we serve, and we act to meet immediate needs without delay. Our programs help empower people to improve their lives and their communities. We see poverty as an unacceptable reality for our neighbors and rally with key partners to help facilitate change.

We are passionate about advocating for those living in poverty and creating equity throughout the region

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst -Remote
new_jobs.description:
Data Analyst

**Position Title:** Data Analyst**Department:** Technology**Reports To:** Chief Technology Officer**Location:** Remote**Employment Type:** Full\-time**Travel Requirement:** 0–10%**About MedZed**
================


MedZed is a leader in delivering value\-based, technology\-enabled social support to high\-cost Medicaid members who are unreachable and disconnected from their primary care provider. We combine innovative outreach and care models with technology to find and engage members, connect them to primary care, and improve outcomes. Our intervention yields reduced costs and assists our members in enhancing their quality of life. MedZed is a growth\-stage, PE\-backed healthcare services company serving high\-cost Medicaid recipients through Community Health Navigators. With 330 employees operating across three states, we connect underserved populations to the social and health resources they need. We are scaling rapidly and investing in data and analytics as a core enabler of that growth.**Position Overview**
=====================


We are building MedZed’s analytics function and looking for a Data Analyst who will be a core contributor on a lean team — someone who can own and drive the analytics products the business runs on. This is a highly visible, hands\-on role: you will build the data sources, construct the dashboards, write the SQL and Python, document your work, train the people who use it, and own the backlog of enhancement requests. You will be a partner with product, operations, clinical, finance, and program leadership to turn their questions into decision\-grade analytics. You will operate with autonomy, be held to high standards of rigor and polish, and deliver with fast turnaround. This is not a role for someone who wants narrowly scoped tickets; it is for an exceptionally strong technical analyst who runs toward ownership, accountability, and visibility.**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Build and Own the Analytics Products**
Design, build, and maintain the curated data sources, dashboards, and reports that drive operational decision\-making across our programs. Own each product end to end — from requirements through building, documentation, training, and ongoing enhancement.**Write the SQL and Shape the Data Model**
Develop, optimize, and maintain SQL against our cloud data environment. Partner with data engineering to expose the data you need, and contribute to a sustainable, well\-structured analytical layer. Articulate data requirements clearly and build for performance and reuse.**Automate Recurring Reporting**
Build and maintain Python\-based reporting pipelines for recurring operational, compliance, and quality deliverables. Validate rigorously — reconcile numbers to source, QA before release, and stand behind the figures you publish.**Document, Train, and Maintain**
Produce clear documentation for the data sources and dashboards you build. Train and enable the people who use them. Maintain a prioritized backlog of enhancement requests and re\-prioritize as the business needs shift.**Qualifications**
==================

**Education \& Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in quantitative discipline, or a degree plus equivalent real\-world experience as a data analyst.
* 3\+ years in data analytics roles, with a demonstrated ability to drive complex work to decision and resolution.
* Strong SQL skills — you can articulate what you need, build a sustainable model, and optimize performance.
* Advanced dashboarding/BI skills; Tableau strongly preferred (experience with product\-embedded dashboards a plus).
* Proficiency with Python for data work (pandas and related libraries) and report automation.
* Strong, audience\-aware written and verbal communication, with the ability to work in a self\-directed environment on a lean team.
* Laser focuses on results: getting things done on time with high quality
**Preferred*** Healthcare analytics experience, especially Medicaid and California CalAIM; EMR or care management system reporting.
* Familiarity with dimensional/Kimball data modeling and the bronze/silver/gold (medallion) pattern.
* Azure (SQL, cloud data services); exposure to Databricks a plus.
* Familiarity with Salesforce / Health Cloud as a data source.
* Comfort using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate development — with the judgment to validate and hone generated output.
* Customer\-facing experience in an analytics role.
**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Remote\-first work environment
* High\-impact role
* The opportunity to build meaningful analytics products at a mission\-driven healthcare company
**Physical Requirements**
=========================

* This position requires the employee to remain in a stationary position for prolonged periods while performing desk\-based computer tasks.
* The employee must be able to constantly operate a computer, keyboard, and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.
* The person in this position may need to occasionally move about inside the office/remote workspace to access file cabinets, office machinery, or other resources.
* The employee may occasionally be required to lift and move objects weighing up to 10 pounds (e.g., a laptop, files, or small office equipment).
* Clarity of vision at approximately 20 inches or less is required for working with computers and reading small print.

**Reasonable Accommodation**
============================


Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), it is our policy to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause undue hardship. *MedZed is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Senior - Coordinated Entry Systems (Short-Term Employment)
new_jobs.description:
**Your Role**

The Medi\-Cal Operational Readiness team leads cross\-functional implementation and operational readiness for Medi\-Cal programs, including CalAIM initiatives that support members experiencing homelessness. The Program Manager, Senior \- Coordinated Entry System will report to the Senior Manager, Program and Project Management. In this role, you will serve as Blue Shield’s primary connection to local homelessness response systems, community\-based organizations, and Continuums of Care. You will help ensure Blue Shield’s investments in street medicine, Enhanced Care Management, Community Supports, Transitional Rent, and related homelessness programs are aligned toward housing stability for members while strengthening program effectiveness, accountability, and real\-world outcomes.


Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high\-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.


  
**Your Work**

In this role, you will:


* Serve as Blue Shield’s primary liaison to Coordinated Entry System partners, Continuums of Care, community\-based organizations, and regional homelessness response systems
* Represent Blue Shield in CoC board meetings, workgroups, regional planning meetings, and other community forums, including LAHSA and RTFH engagement
* Provide training and technical assistance to CES partners and community\-based organizations on Medi\-Cal benefits available to members experiencing homelessness, including ECM, Community Supports, non\-emergency medical transportation, pharmacy benefits, street medicine, Transitional Rent, and redetermination
